publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
notes: Two CSV attachments stitched: 2003-2017 frozen file and 2018-present current file. Reference date is the Monday of the week. GOV.UK change history supplies official release timestamps from 2013-09-23 only; earlier weeks are marked availability_basis=inferred. No published revision policy was found on the source page.

publisher: Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs
notes: Official ODS supplies 2015 onward history and tidy CSV supplies the modern 2017 onward period. The artifacts are reconciled in overlap with deterministic CSV precedence and a one-penny published-rounding tolerance; material divergence fails. GOV.UK change history proves modern release timestamps, while earlier history is availability_basis=inferred. cut_flowers and pot_plants are published but not collected. 127 series, 23801 observations verified 2026-09-16.

Directly sets the CPI electricity and gas components on cap-change dates. Machine-readable artifact, full history and licence not yet verified against Ofgem. Announced well ahead of the effective date, so the point-in-time treatment must distinguish announcement date from effective date.

publisher: Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs
notes: Tidy machine-readable CSV carries the whole weekly history in GBP per kg; 28 series after label normalisation, 14264 observations. Reference date is the Friday of the week, published the following Monday (modal lag 3 days). GOV.UK change history begins 2019-07-21, so pre-2019 weeks are availability_basis=inferred. DEFRA relabelled its aggregates at the 2018/2019 boundary (all_bananas_bananas -> all_bananas, likewise dollar and ACP) with zero overlap; a doubled _bananas suffix is collapsed. The two ODS workbooks restate the CSV and are not parsed. No published revision policy was found.

Clearances and receipts for tobacco, published periodically. This is activity data, not the duty parameter: the duty RATE is registered separately as hmrc_tobacco_duty_rates. File layout, history and release dates not yet verified.

Clearances and receipts for alcohol, published periodically. Activity data, not the duty parameter; the duty RATE is registered separately as hmrc_alcohol_duty_rates. File layout, history and release dates not yet verified.

source_name: UK milk prices and composition of milk
publisher: Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs
notes: Prices_Monthly sheet of the official ODS. Five published columns: price in pence per litre from 1970-01, delivered volume, weekly average volume, butterfat and protein from the mid-1990s. 5 series, 2200 observations. Published roughly 8 weeks after the reference month on the last Thursday. Change history begins 2013-04-30, so earlier months are availability_basis=inferred. DEFRA stamps 2017-01 to 2023-12 with month-end dates and the rest with month-start; reference dates are canonicalised to the first of the month. No Nov or Dec 1994. The change history records revisions to already-published months (for example 2026-08-03 and 2026-08-05). Prices_Annual is a DEFRA aggregation and is not collected.

publisher: Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs
notes: Current 2020=100 CSV only, January 2014 onward: 106 series (output and input), 15708 observations. Published roughly 12 weeks after the reference month on the last Thursday; change history begins 2013-04-18, before this file's history, so every observation carries availability_basis=official_timestamp. Archived workbooks on 2015=100 (from 1988), 2010=100, 2005=100 and 2000=100 are described by DEFRA as archive-only and are NOT chained: no rebasing factor is published. The base year is encoded in every series_id (..._B2020). The change history records backseries corrections (for example fertiliser, 2026-05-01).

Wholesale electricity Market Index Price and Volume per market participant, upstream of the retail energy cap. Published per settlement date and settlement period. time_series.reference_date is a DATE, so the settlement period must be encoded in series_id (for example ELEXON_MID_N2EX_PRICE_SP01) rather than adding a column; aggregation to daily, monthly or MTD belongs to this research layer. BMRS/Elexon API terms, endpoints and licence not yet verified.

Regulated rail fares are set annually by formula. ORR data-portal tables 7180 and 7182 are the candidate fares tables and must be confirmed against the current portal before coding. Collect fares cuts only (regulated, unregulated, ticket type, overall); passenger usage is a different series and is out of scope even though it sits in the same portal area.

Local bus fares index, candidate table BUS0415. Frequency, dimensions, regional breakdown, history and the current workbook must be re-verified against DfT before coding: the previously registered annual frequency is not confirmed. Persist published regional and national indices raw; do not aggregate to a CPI basis in the collector.

Telecoms pricing feeds CPI communication. Ofcom's research pages returned HTTP 403 to an automated request, so no source URL, format or licence could be confirmed. Must be verified manually before any collection.
Used-car price index, relevant to CPI second-hand cars. Published inside press releases rather than as a data file; commercial publisher, so redistribution terms must be checked before collection.

Asking-rent indicators, relevant to CPI actual rentals. Both sites returned HTTP 403 to an automated request and neither publishes an open data file. Scraping is explicitly out of scope for this repository, so this entry stays registered and unimplemented until a licensed feed is identified.

Tax parameter, changed at fiscal events and usually announced in advance of the effective date. announcement_date, effective_date and reference_date must be kept distinct: the rate is knowable from the announcement, not from the date it takes effect. Layout and history not yet verified.
